**Answer: (2) Sāṃkhya.**

Sāṃkhya is dualist: **puruṣa** (pure consciousness, many) and **prakṛti** (unconscious matter made of the three guṇas). Creation is prakṛti's evolution into 23 tattvas for the sake of puruṣa; liberation is discriminating puruṣa from prakṛti. Yoga accepts this metaphysics and adds Īśvara.

Vedānta (Advaita) holds one reality, Brahman; Vaiśeṣika works with categories and atoms; Mīmāṃsā with Vedic ritual.
